summary: Tested Phase 3b Execution Mode end-to-end: 8/8 backend tests pass and all UI assertions pass. Backend snapshot returns the right shape (is_running, 4 health tiers, stats, logs, feedback, snapshot_at). Comment/feature/bug feedback all post correctly; bug-kind auto-creates a real dev_bug_reports entry that appears in GET /bugs. 404 returned for unknown project on snapshot+feedback POST. Frontend page /dev-os/projects/:projectId/execution renders with all required data-testids (exec-toggle-poll, exec-health-{api,db,frontend,agents}, exec-stats, exec-log-stream + 24 log lines, exec-kind-bug, exec-feedback-message, exec-feedback-submit). BuildConsole has bc-open-execution linking correctly. ProjectDetail tabs (Bugs/Memory/Comments/Releases) load without regression.
critical_code_review_comments: services/dev_os_execution.py: GET /execution/feedback list endpoint does NOT verify project ownership (it only filters by workspace_id + project_id). If a caller passes a bogus project_id, it returns 200 with []. Snapshot and POST feedback both correctly 404. Consider adding the same project ownership check to the list endpoint for consistency and to prevent enumeration of project_id values across workspaces.

ExecutionMode.jsx polling: timer uses POLL_MS=4s with setInterval and the route also calls loadProject on mount only. If the project is renamed after page open, the AppBar will keep showing the old name until the page is reloaded. Minor.

submit_feedback() in dev_os_execution.py: when kind='bug', the auto-created bug title is `message[:80]` while the description is the full message — but the message is passed through .strip() only for the stored feedback row, NOT before slicing for the bug title (line 165). Edge case: leading whitespace in the message will yield a title that starts with spaces. Cosmetic only.
Stat color logic uses `error_rate_pct > 1` threshold — fine, but consider exposing the threshold as a constant so design and SRE agree on what 'red' means.

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_-prefixed dev_execution_feedback rows and one auto-created bug (TEST_bug auto-create iteration58…) in dev_bug_reports for project 9f213c9e-7cfb-436d-a133-7d6df21d2d30. These are deterministic test data, not destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Execution Mode is fully wired. Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration58_execution_mode.py covers snapshot shape, 3 feedback kinds, bug auto-creation, list, 404s. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set. Frontend page route is /dev-os/projects/:projectId/execution and links from BuildConsole via [data-testid=bc-open-execution]. is_running depends on dev_builds having at least one build_status='success'; the seeded demo project already satisfies this so logs render with 24 lines.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional defects found. Only minor code-review notes captured above.
